reasons: The user fixed the n1 teaching family and six-pair budget; no additional orders or four-state fitting are authorized here.

OU plus measurement noise has the best nominal AICc among the four declared pooled kernels. This is a working description, not proof of Gaussian residual adequacy.

limitations: The shared n1 mean/error model does not fully explain the thirty-second sine records under the checked assumptions. Conditional uncertainty cannot certify absence of model bias.
Tier0 inspected all twelve recordings. Subsequent ten-record evaluation per pair is retrospective conditional on the chosen structure.
Ambient reference is the first sensor reading, not an independent ambient measurement. The +/-2C bound is consequential: widening it to +/-4C shifts pooled K about -2.47%.
The startup checks are fixed, limited scenarios, not a probability law or an independent-per-run worst-case uncertainty envelope.

Ambient forcing enters the thermal state in this reduced model. Pole assignment depends on that disturbance channel, initialization and nuisance assumptions; do not impose an ordering or identify physical heater/sensor constants merely from fitted labels.

Gaussian parametric bootstrap is conditional on a working noise family. Innovation-block resampling is a sensitivity to remaining dependence; it does not repair deterministic input-related bias or guarantee coverage.

Unknown evaluation ambient is propagated as bounded scenarios, not a fabricated probability prior. Full-response fitted ambient corrections are conditional reconstructions, not prospective predictions.
